evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never delivers the time-boxed framing or waits for explicit yes. Jumps directly into confirming details: 'Alright. So yeah, let me just go ahead and pull up your account here...'
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Moving day (Sunday Oct 4), size (1200 sq ft partial move), route (7011 Gas to Parkway → 5324 Columbia Ave), and name confirmed. No 'city-to-city' routing as separate items.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep launches directly into logistics probing after brief scheduling discussion.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Not applicable — no concerns were raised by the customer.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Not applicable — no concerns were raised by the customer.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Covered: property type (two-story house to two-story townhome/apartment), floor/stories (yes, second floor items), number/type of items (15 large furniture pieces), special considerations (checked for pianos, safes, washers/dryers, antiques—all no), access concerns (none noted). Partial — did not explicitly ask about 'additional rooms' or 'walking distance' as distinct probes.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. Rep discusses furniture only, no mention of packing services.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked. Irrelevant given partial move, but not explicitly offered.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Gave typical range ($707–$909 for 3.5–4.5 hrs) and personalized to heavy furniture requiring two people, multiple floors, careful handling, and buffer for potential miscounting: 'So the reason why I'm quoting three and a half to four and a half hours is because of the factors involved...large and heavy furniture so extra care and preparation are needed...'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Both present: (1) Fee transparency upfront — 'no heating fees anytime, no credit card fees, no deposit, no transportation fees, no terrible fees, no disassemble or reassembly fees. Again no hidden fees anytime.' (2) Minimum and increment framing: 'minimum of two and a half hours...prorated in fifteen minute increments' and 'you will only be charged for the actual hours standard.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moves directly from estimate explanation to 'Do you have questions or clarifications about it ma'am?' Customer says 'No, that's fine.' Rep never says 'Does that feel fair?' or pauses for reflection.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Fully delivered with discount terms: 'if we can't make it in the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money off your final bill.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Fully delivered: '$2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages' and 'all of that is included at no extra cost' (framed as no-deductible, built-in).
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Does not close the loop. Mentions both promises but does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar confirmation. No repeat issue, but no explicit closing either.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Throwaway version. After booking confirmed, rep asks 'will there be anything else that I can help you with today?' — empty 'anything else' language, not genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' appears in transcript.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full. 'So would you like our help with your move this coming Sunday? October 4th?' — asked plainly without an out. Customer says 'Yes, that would be great.'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Mentioned: 'no upfront payment, no deposit' and email confirmation is 'your reference that you have a confirmed scheduled with Einstein.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: (1) Date/day (Sunday, October 4th), (2) Arrival window (8:30–9:00 AM), (3) Phone number NOT confirmed in transcript. (4) Crew size NOT explicitly confirmed (mentions 'two movers' in rate structure but not crew size for this booking). (5) Addresses confirmed (7011 Gas to Parkway → 5324 Columbia Ave). (6) Notes for crew about customer concerns NOT left or discussed. Missing 3+ items.

top_strength: Rep nailed the estimate anchor and pricing framing—gave a clear, personalized range ($707–$909) tied to the specific factors (heavy furniture, two stories, careful handling) and fully disclosed all-inclusive structure with no hidden fees, making the quote transparent and defensible.
coaching_note: Section 2 (Their Concerns) was completely skipped—rep never asked 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' before probing logistics, which is the highest-value item in the call card and the foundation for trust-building; add this question early, every call.
